## Slaplock

**Lock any app behind Face ID or Touch ID**, with your passcode as a backup. Nothing is locked until you pick apps in Settings → Slaplock.

- A locked app asks again every time you come back to it.
- Its preview in the App Switcher is hidden.

- **iOS 15 to 17.** Rootless jailbreaks. A RootHide version comes with the next update.
- Tested on an iPhone 8 Plus (iOS 16.7) and an iPhone SE 2nd gen (iOS 17.5.1).
- If it ever sends your phone to Safe Mode, open Sileo (it still works there) and uninstall it. Then [tell me](https://github.com/Jond-ie/repo/issues).

- Found a way around the lock? [Tell me](https://github.com/Jond-ie/repo/issues). That's the most useful report there is.
- Needs **AltList** and **PreferenceLoader**. Sileo installs them for you.
